accordion.a4Locked: Fixed: this session has already recorded against it.
accordion.columnsRefused: This change would alter the reed ranks used by existing readings. The change was not saved. Restore the previous ranks or create a new session.
accordion.frozen: The reference pitch and reed ranks cannot change after readings are recorded. You can still add registers using the existing ranks.
accordion.rememberHint: Save this session's instrument to the library for use in future sessions.

card.changed: The accordion on the shelf has changed since this session was recorded.

curve.clearAllConfirm: Every anchor is taken out. The goal goes back to the scale pitch for every note, and the tuner becomes a plain indicator.
curve.clearAllHint: Take every anchor out and leave the goal at the scale pitch.

help.hz: Hz enters a goal in hertz, read at A4 = 440 Hz as the reference beat list does, so it does not move with the session's A4. Recorded lays this session's readings over the list, and List can fit the anchors to them or copy another session's list.
help.interp: With Interpolate on, notes between your anchors follow the line; off, each anchor holds until the next. With no anchors the goal is the scale pitch everywhere.
help.lead: The goal you are tuning toward: how far each reed should sit from its scale pitch, note by note. A recorded reed is read against this, so the table calls it in or out against your target, not against dead-centre.
help.set: Pick a note and a value and press Set, or drag a point on the chart up or down. Each rank is its own line, and the one you are editing is highlighted.

curve.interpolateHint: Follow the line between anchors. Off, each anchor holds until the next one.

menu.fitBody: The anchors are replaced by a curve fitted to the one reading. | The anchors are replaced by a curve fitted to {n} readings.
menu.label: List
menu.replaceBody: The anchors are replaced by the other list, with its settings.

curve.recordedHint: Show this session's readings on the graph
curve.removeHint: Take this note’s anchor out of the curve.
curve.scaleHint: How far up and down the graph reaches
curve.setHint: Put an anchor on this note for the rank selected.
curve.startHint: No anchors yet. The goal is the scale pitch for every note.

session.deleteHint: Permanently delete this session, including all passes, readings and its tuning curve.

dialog.name: Session name
dialog.nameHint: Use an instrument or customer name to identify the session.

session.emptyHint: Create a session to save measurements, or use the tuner without one.

error.fitFailed: Could not fit a curve to that pass.
error.hasReadings: This session already holds readings: they were all measured against its reference and reed count, so neither can change now.
error.instrumentName: Give the accordion a name so you can find it again.
error.invalidA4: The reference pitch must be between 430 and 450 Hz.
error.invalidInstrument: That accordion cannot be used: a reed rank is named twice, or a register sounds a rank the accordion does not have.
error.invalidNote: That note is outside the range the tuner tracks.
error.invalidReed: This accordion does not sound that reed.
error.invalidReedCount: An accordion sounds between 1 and 8 reeds on a note.
error.invalidUnit: Values are entered in units of 0.06 %, in cents or in hertz.
error.invalidValue: That value is not a number.
error.noBassMachine: This accordion declares no bass machine.
error.noBassRegister: The accordion has no such bass register.
error.noCurve: This session has no goal curve.
error.noReadings: Nothing has been recorded in this session yet.
error.noRegister: This accordion has no such register.
error.notAnImage: That file is not a photograph.
error.saveFailed: Could not save the session. Your last takes may be lost if you close now.

instrument.a4Hint: Reference frequency of A4 in hertz. New sessions for this instrument use this value.

bass.fixed: No bass registers: a fixed machine, every voice always sounds.
bass.full: A bass machine here carries at most {n} switches
bass.hint: Declare how many voices the bass sounds; most machines have four or five.

builder.none: No switches yet. Pick the ranks each one sounds, below.
builder.title: Add a switch

instrument.name: Name
instrument.nameHint: Name shown in the instrument library and sessions.

range.backwards: The highest note must not be lower than the lowest note.
range.hint: Optional. The lowest and highest key. You can also set it by ear during calibration.
range.label: Keyboard range

instrument.registersHint: Click the dots of each switch's symbol - the circle engraved on the accordion - or pick a common one. What it sounds is read straight off the dots.
instrument.registersSubtitle: The treble-side switches, and the ranks each one sounds.
instrument.says: Reed ranks {banks}. The widest switch sounds {reeds} reed. | Reed ranks {banks}. The widest switch sounds {reeds} reeds.
instrument.toleranceHint: Allowed reed deviation in units of 0.06% of the note frequency. Readings outside this range are marked out of tune.

session.title: Sessions
